**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Miss Bramston](../persons.html#198)[^1]
I shall have much pleasure in dining with you next Thursday It is lucky the [lectures](../others.html#240) are over today, or it would not have been easy to manage it[^2]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Mary Bramston is recorded in the 1871 census living in Winchester with her brother [John](../persons.html#196) who was a master at [Winchester College](../others.html#50).

[^2]: The Englishwoman’s Review 1 (January 1870), 27 notes, \'Lectures to ladies on English literature are to be given by Professor Morley, at Winchester in the autumn.\'
